faq.title: Common Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about FORMA Pilates
faq.teamHelp: Our team is here to help you with anything you need

experience.q: Do I need prior Pilates experience to join?
experience.a: Not at all! We welcome practitioners of all levels. Our instructors are trained to modify exercises for beginners while challenging advanced students. We recommend starting with a private session to assess your fitness level and goals.

wear.q: What should I wear to a Pilates session?
wear.a: Wear comfortable, form-fitting clothing that allows freedom of movement. Avoid loose or baggy clothes as they can interfere with exercises. We practice barefoot or in grip socks (available for purchase at the studio).

frequency.q: How often should I practice Pilates?
frequency.a: For optimal results, we recommend 2-3 sessions per week. However, even one session weekly can provide benefits. Consistency is more important than frequency—find a schedule that works for your lifestyle.

matVsReformer.q: What is the difference between mat and reformer Pilates?
matVsReformer.a: Mat Pilates uses body weight for resistance on a floor mat. Reformer Pilates uses a specialized machine with springs providing adjustable resistance. The reformer offers more variety and can be gentler on joints while providing a more challenging workout.

injuries.q: Can I do Pilates if I have injuries or physical limitations?
injuries.a: Pilates is often recommended for rehabilitation! However, please inform us of any injuries or conditions before your first session. Our instructors can modify exercises to accommodate most limitations and help support your recovery.

cancellation.a: We require 24 hours notice for cancellations. Late cancellations or no-shows will be charged the full session fee. We understand emergencies happen—please contact us as soon as possible if you need to reschedule.

packages.q: Do you offer packages or memberships?
packages.a: Yes! We offer various packages for private, duo, and group sessions, as well as monthly memberships. Packages offer significant savings compared to single sessions. Visit our pricing section or contact us for details.

parking.q: Is parking available at the studio?
parking.a: Yes, we have dedicated parking spaces for our clients. Street parking is also available in the surrounding area. Our studio is conveniently located and accessible by public transport as well.
